name: Maahes Noon Bastion
loreTies: Sacred order channels solar power into civilization.
Solar Law: coordinated Titans gain defensive clarity after holding objectives.
Maahes Noon Bastion is a colossal Aten Ra Titan shaped by sacred order channels solar power into civilization. It manifests the Realm's law through battlefield-scale mythic force.
shortBackstory: Maahes Noon Bastion carries the lion war-protection humans later carved as Maahes and Sekhmet-adjacent temple guardians. He is the noon gate’s living roar: mercy behind him, knives before him, captives judged in his shadow.

chapters.title: Origin
chapters.text: Maahes Noon Bastion began as more than a weapon in The Golden Dominion of Aten. Maahes Noon Bastion was bound to a solar pylon during a Gate disturbance that tested whether sacred order channels solar power into civilization could survive contact with the Hollow. The title carried in their name was earned when the Titan chose duty over spectacle and accepted a burden ordinary soldiers could not survive.

chapters.title: Faction Bond
chapters.text: Among the Aten Ra, Maahes Noon Bastion is treated as proof that a divine solar civilization of judgment, radiance, command, sacred order, temple law, and ancient solar mathematics can become battlefield doctrine without losing its soul. Their silhouette carries gold, bronze, sacred geometry, solar light, obsidian enamel, amber radiance, pyramid-pylon armor forms, but their real identity is tactical: defensive command, radiant control, judgment zones, solar sustain. Every deployment makes faction philosophy visible through movement, restraint, and force.

chapters.title: Gate Wound
chapters.text: The Gate did not simply attack Maahes Noon Bastion; it tried to measure what their Realm values most. The wound echoed sacred doctrine back as bait, tempting the Titan to overextend, break battle line, or turn culture into raw fuel. Maahes Noon Bastion survived by refusing the Gate's terms, leaving a scar that still reacts whenever judgment zones appears on the map.

chapters.title: Campaign Role
chapters.text: In The First Reopening, Maahes Noon Bastion gives the campaign a personal lens on faction survival. Their presence reinforces the rule that faction identity stays distinct unless a mission explicitly permits otherwise. In a 5-Titan Titan, Maahes Noon Bastion turns Solar Law from a passive rule into a story statement: the Realm is defending its meaning.

chapters.title: Personal Conflict
chapters.text: Maahes Noon Bastion's flaw is overcommitment to the belief that their Realm's answer must always be enough. NPC witnesses and rival factions challenge that certainty as the Hollow learns to imitate law, oath, balance, life, radiance, and ambition without understanding any of them. Their battlefield stats support this arc: HP 32, attack 9, range 3, speed 2, energy 3.

relationshipHooks: Mesha and other Codex witnesses can interpret their Gate scar.
developmentStatus: Readable profile integrated into dashboard character pages.

visualCanon: Guardian Titan with lion-mane gold collar, leonine but readable humanoid-divine anatomy, knife-like bronze bracers, lotus crest, sun-red war markings, massive intercepting forearms, and heat-haze roar aura. Avoid furry beastman or generic lion monster; he is royal protective violence.
